remarks: Why rent, when you and buy? Step into this sun-filled first-floor one bedroom corner unit condo, offering an inviting blend of comfort and convenience. The spacious layout features a bright living area with a sliding door that opens to a private patio - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The generous bedroom includes a walk-in closet, providing ample storage space. Washer & Dryer inside unit & On Demand Hot Water Tank! Storage bin in basement. Located in the vibrant South Norwalk (SoNo) neighborhood, you're just steps away from beaches, trendy cafes, acclaimed restaurants, Norwalk train station, The SoNo Collection and the Maritime Aquarium. Enjoy the best of coastal living with all the amenities of city life right at your doorstep. Easy access to Interstate 95 for commuting. Must be owner occupied. No Pets. Subject to Seller finding suitable housing. Make your appointment today!
